description: This peaceful walk in Ripon takes you along a pleasant section of the River Ure. The route runs for a distance of about 7.5 miles, passing along a section of the Ripon Rowel. Starting in the centre of Ripon you head east along the waymarked footpath before turning north along the riverside path. This will take you past Sharow and North Stanley before finishing in West Tanfield. Along the way you'll enjoy fine views over the surrounding Yorkshire countryside and hills. You can continue your walking in the area on the Ripon to Fountains Abbey Walk and the Ripon Canal Walk .
